name: Unverified USDC/WETH liquidity pool credits nested reentrant liquidity additions against one payment
summary: Unverified pool 0x39ed372f8e9f316029994ca7f73b6683829c6b08 records liquidity and tick reserves in function 0xbe16634e before settlement, then calls back msg.sender without a reentrancy guard and checks payment per call. The attacker re-entered the add path 20 levels deep from the callback, paid once in the deepest frame to satisfy every nested balance check, and then removed the inflated liquidity, taking the pool's entire 7,167.42 USDC and 2.05 WETH.

loss.notes: The pool's full pre-exploit USDC and WETH balances, net of the attacker's own deposits in the transaction. The attacker's separate Uniswap V3 USDC->WETH swap is its own trade and not counted.

ageReset.description: Direct unverified runtime with no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT and an empty EIP-1967 implementation slot, created by CREATE2 from factory 0x6ed3c23f3c4cd1103d7f782e8e38403a4be0e24c; the pool has no admin transactions before the exploit, so deployment is the only code change.

limitations: The pool runtime is unverified; the reentrant accounting is established from the exploit trace and BlockSec's analysis, not from source.

sources.note: source-1 (24714205:24): contract creation by 0x7bd73663 deploying 0x8b7557a1, which creates 0x93a8b59c; 0x93a8b59c unlocks Uniswap V4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90 and takes USDC and WETH. callTracer: 21 calls to pool 0x39ed372f function 0xbe16634e; each of the first 20 calls back 0x93a8b59c.0x7c65be42, which re-enters 0xbe16634e (maximum nesting 20); only the deepest frame transfers WETH and USDC to the pool, and each frame reads USDC balanceOf(pool) for its per-call check; the 21st call removes liquidity and the pool transfers 2309904757397529099 WETH and 11087114910 USDC to 0x93a8b59c. Artifact: eth_getCode empty at 24248230; keccak(runtime) 0x843c61672d5bc1e4e366120857ba180b00f6ac2865c1cd2208b7abf536cdd7e8 at 24248231 and 24714204 (contains selector 0xbe16634e; no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT; EIP-1967 slot zero); source-2 (24248231:88, from 0xa9e4513754c3a86e752009d273f0c9eaee6a12a3 via 0x5795eb76) shows factory 0x6ed3c23f CREATE2 of the pool; unverified on Etherscan. First exercise: Etherscan txlist of the pool to 24714205 has 4 failed swap calls only; tokentx of the pool (51 transfers, complete): before source-1 only deployer-side dust deposits/withdrawals by 0x791a1c44/0xcf7c7dd6 (outflows not exceeding inflows, all below 0.004 WETH) and LP deposits by 0xeeb65fe5 (24276590..24277554, about 2.07 WETH and 7,151 USDC, plus two small swaps); no earlier outflow exceeds its sender's deposit, so source-1 is the first drain. codeAgeSeconds = 1774196435 - 1768577855 = 5618580.

Loss: eth_call balanceOf(pool 0x39ed372f8e9f316029994ca7f73b6683829c6b08) at 24714204 / 24714205: USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 7167421642 / 0 (6 decimals, valued at par); WETH 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 2051722686006911310 / 0, valued at the DefiLlama WETH price (source-5) 2081.7283718777853 = 4,271.13 USD. Pool Transfer logs of source-1: in 115495237869876455 + 142686833520741334 WETH and 554355746 + 3365337522 USDC from the attacker, out 2309904757397529099 WETH and 11087114910 USDC; net equals the balance change. Total 11,438.55 USD.
